name: difaac-backend-dev
description: Task runner for the backend during local development. There is no JavaScript here: the backend is Python, and this file exists so `npm run dev` starts it the same way it starts the frontend. It serves HTTPS because vite.config.ts proxies /api and /auth to https://localhost:8000 — the certificate is the mkcert pair at the repository root, the same one vite-plugin-mkcert trusts. Deleting this file leaves the proxy pointing at a server nothing starts, and the browser reports a bare 500 with no explanation.
